title: Build breaks on agents:skills import, SkillRegistry or skillWorkspace after Agents SDK 0.32.0
symptoms: Cannot resolve the agents:skills Vite import
agents/skills/compile or SkillRegistry is not found
Think skillWorkspace option no longer works
cause: Skills moved to plain files in the agent Workspace. The agents:skills Vite import, agents/skills/compile, SkillRegistry and Think's skillWorkspace were removed, and runner() moved to agents/skills/runner.
fix: Upgrade to Agents SDK 0.32.0 and Think 0.23.0 or later, return skills.workspace(this.workspace) or skills.r2(...) from getSkills(), and import runner from agents/skills/runner.
affected: Agents SDK before 0.32.0 migrating, Think before 0.23.0, from 2026-10-29
